review:
{
  "spec": "This change extends the todo app to support optional due dates (YYYY-MM-DD) and task completion status. The `add` command accepts a `--due` flag, and the `list` command displays due dates alongside task text. New `done` and `overdue` commands allow users to mark tasks complete and filter for late tasks. The storage layer handles backward compatibility for files without due dates or done flags, ensuring old JSON files load correctly.",
  "stack": "Python, json, argparse, datetime, pytest",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "title": "Add due_date field to Task model",
      "files": ["todo/model.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_model_defaults checks that Task initializes with due_date=None",
      "check": "python -c \"from todo.model import Task; t = Task(1, 'x'); print(t.due_date)\"",
      "expect": "None"
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "title": "Update storage to load and save due_date",
      "files": ["todo/storage.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_old_file_loads checks that loading a JSON file without 'due_date' results in None",
      "check": "python -c \"import json; from todo.storage import load; open('t.json','w').write(json.dumps([{'id':1,'text':'x'}])); print(load('t.json')[0].due_date)\"",
      "expect": "None"
    },
    {
      "id": 3,
      "title": "Add --due argument to add command",
      "files": ["todo/cli.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_add_with_due checks that --due sets the date on the new task",
      "check": "python -c \"from todo.cli import main; main(['add', 'x', '--due', '2023-01-01'], 't.json'); from todo.storage import load; print(load('t.json')[0].due_date)\"",
      "expect": "2023-01-01"
    },
    {
      "id": 4,
      "title": "Update render to show due date",
      "files": ["todo/listing.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_list_shows_due_date checks that render includes the due date",
      "check": "python -c \"from todo.model import Task; from todo.listing import render; print(render([Task(1, 'x', due_date='2023-01-01')]))\"",
      "expect": "1 [ ] x (2023-01-01)"
    },
    {
      "id": 5,
      "title": "Implement done command",
      "files": ["todo/cli.py", "todo/storage.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_done_marks_task checks that done ID sets done=True",
      "check": "python -c \"from todo.cli import main; main(['add', 'x'], 't.json'); main(['done', '1'], 't.json'); from todo.storage import load; print(load('t.json')[0].done)\"",
      "expect": "True"
    },
    {
      "id": 6,
      "title": "Implement overdue command",
      "files": ["todo/cli.py", "todo/listing.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_overdue_lists_late_tasks checks that overdue returns only late incomplete tasks",
      "check": "python -c \"from todo.cli import main; main(['add', 'x', '--due', '2020-01-01'], 't.json'); print(main(['overdue'], 't.json'))\"",
      "expect": "1 [ ] x (2020-01-01)"
    }
  ]
}
